content.title: Embodied Everyday Consequence | Reminder, Refusal, Corrective Action
content.summary: An illustrator ignores a save reminder until paper moths force one corrective click. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One simple rule is visible before it is ignored. + The subject performs a clear refusal or delay. + The consequence grows from the violated state. + The consequence remains in the same daily geography. + Only the matching corrective action restores order.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult night illustrator at a cluttered desk beside a small animated blue timer that points to the exact reminder SAVE YOUR WORK. Grow three translucent paper moths from the red icon, each carrying one fragment of the unfinished drawing. The fragments return to the page, the icon turns green and the timer gives one restrained confirming nod.
required_anchors: One simple rule is visible before it is ignored.
The subject performs a clear refusal or delay.
The consequence remains in the same daily geography.
Only the matching corrective action restores order.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An illustrator ignores a save reminder until paper moths force one corrective click. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
